resources.string: OpenAerialMap tracing · BETA

Pan and zoom the coverage map, then Search explicitly. Tap a footprint or open Sources to inspect every result. Green: supported; orange: rejected; blue: searched area; white: movable 128 m trace selection. Local map detail requires downloaded atlas/MBTiles; no basemap tiles are fetched here. Select a supported source, move the white box inside it, then Load centre. Tracing: 1–256 m per side, 512 × 512 pixels, GSD ≤ 0.5 m, north-up EPSG:4326. Magenta is an unverified candidate, NOT a road or walk. Local drafts/export only; no OSM upload.
